verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a compliance and registered-agent service, not an AI agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: Wolters Kluwer's main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy CT host redirects into that walled host. Nothing in the pack shows any MCP server, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
